key_points.text: In the fallout from the pandemic.
key_points.evidence_quote: In the fallout from the pandemic, most founders and CEOs are in the process of completely revamping their growth models from the bottom up amid new and unpredictable consumer behavior.

key_points.text: This episode explores how to think about growth in turbulent times, according to two growth experts, A16Z general partner Andrew Chen.
key_points.evidence_quote: This episode explores how to think about growth in turbulent times, according to two growth experts, A16Z general partner Andrew Chen, who previously led the growth team at Uber, and Brian Balfour, formerly the VP of Growth at HubSpot, now the founder and CEO of Reforge, a masterclass in growth strategies.

thesis: The episode argues that in turbulent times, most growth models must be completely revamped from the bottom up because existing hypotheses about user actions and conversion rates are invalidated by unpredictable consumer behavior. While extreme headwinds or tailwinds make the situation clear, founders in the middle spectrum must proactively talk to customers daily to understand which specific steps in their growth loop are amplifying or contracting.
